notes.title: The checkpoints and the treasure hunt updated.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/af84abad00ecea141c3aebbe999edbb8b524b280.jpg[/img]

Happy lunar new year

Add checkpoint
When the torch is lit, the character's position is saved.
If you die, you can start from that position again.
If you leave the stage, the checkpoint is cleared.

Add treasure hunt
Treasures are hidden every stage.
Treasures have no special powers. It just feels good.

And..
The next update will add the remaining stages.

notes.title: New sound system
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 

New sound system update
- Spatial and directional improvement
- Add reverb

Some bug fixes
- Start position bug when using Oculus device
- Some movement bugs

notes.title: Movement option have been added.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/17ac07b72f586b1065fcfb3e7ab100c7fb200a57.jpg[/img]

- Update
Arm swing, Teleport, Free move options have been added.
All three modes are controlled by the touchpad.
You can change the locomotion by using the above picture book.


- Fixed some bugs

notes.title: (Experimental) Spectator View
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/e307388b5f6e8583a54826b23dd4fd74674c8ab2.jpg[/img]
For third person view.
The person wearing the HMD can see well.
It does not look neat to the viewer.

If you have viewers, try using Spectator View.
- High quality screen
- Auto zoom in, zoom out
- Smooth camera movement

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/13aa76a969eb59c07b809ba82c32c87942c44e10.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33947742/7b49733dd1e69599fc09adb7eaa8e791a6c071b4.jpg[/img]

But you need a high spec computer.
And some functions do not work when Spectator View.
Fade in, fade out, screen shake, and more ..

Please use it and give us your feedback.
